name: SK Square Co., Ltd.
blurb: SK Square Co., Ltd. is a South Korean investment holding company focused on semiconductor and information & communication technologies. Founded in 2021 and headquartered in Icheon-si, the company invests in businesses across South Korea, China, Asia, the United States, and Europe. It operates within the technology sector and is listed on the Korea Exchange under ticker 402340.
recent: Over the past month, SK Square's stock has shown strong performance, with a 52-week range of 91,100 to 1,149,000 KRW. The company reported significant revenue growth of 77.8% year-over-year to 10.46 trillion KRW and net income growth of 137.6% to 8.82 trillion KRW. Upcoming earnings are scheduled for May 15, 2026.
